skill.name: nex-bom-normalizer
skill.description: Standardize, deduplicate, and clean messy Bill of Materials (BOM) files into procurement-ready CSVs. Use when: Deduplicate component lists by merging matching MPNs and Manufacturers; Convert messy EDA exports into a canonical column format for procurement; Automatically fix and uppercase inconsistent reference designators.
skill.summary: Guide BOM cleanup with canonical columns, matching-part merges, normalized reference designators, and missing-data review; automation scripts are not included.
skill.author: nexaiguy

content.value_statement: Inconsistent BOM exports create duplicate orders and incomplete procurement records. This guide defines cleanup rules for column mapping, matching-part merges, reference formatting, and missing-data review.
actual_capabilities: Describes canonical BOM columns, including RefDes, Qty, MPN, and Manufacturer.
Defines deduplication using both manufacturer part number and manufacturer name.
Describes summing quantities when matching rows are merged.
Identifies missing MPN, Qty, or Manufacturer values as candidates for a separate review CSV.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; the referenced Python CLI, extension source, and templates are absent.
CSV and XLSX workflows are described, but executable import and export support cannot be verified from this package.
The guide does not provide external pricing or stock lookups.
Claims of guaranteed data integrity and detailed audit logging cannot be verified without the missing implementation.

use_cases.title: Review EDA Export Cleanup
use_cases.description: Use the documented column and reference rules to review inconsistent Altium, KiCad, or Eagle exports before assembly handoff.

use_cases.title: Consolidate Procurement Lists
use_cases.description: Apply the documented matching criteria when reviewing partial BOMs for consolidation, keeping different manufacturers separate.

use_cases.title: Identify Incomplete Quote Data
use_cases.description: Review required BOM fields and separate incomplete records before requesting a manufacturing quote.

prompt_templates.title: Map BOM Columns
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the guide, map these BOM headers to RefDes, Qty, MPN, and Manufacturer: [headers]. Flag ambiguous mappings without guessing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an unfamiliar export.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Reference Designators
prompt_templates.prompt: Normalize reference designators in these pasted BOM rows to uppercase, comma-separated values: [rows]. Preserve part identifiers and report uncertain entries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic cleanup of pasted component data.

prompt_templates.title: Review Duplicate Parts
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these BOM rows: [rows]. Merge only matching MPN and Manufacturer pairs, sum quantities, and list unresolved conflicts separately.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Validated Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [BOM data] against the guide. Propose column mappings, duplicate merges, quantity checks, and missing-field reports. Identify ambiguities and unavailable automation before changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for a reviewed procurement handoff.

output_examples.input: Two rows share MPN ABC-10 and manufacturer ExampleCo. Quantities are 2 and 1; references are r1, r2, and r3.
output: Proposed merged part: ABC-10 from ExampleCo.

output_examples.input: A BOM row lists reference c5 and quantity 1, but leaves MPN and Manufacturer blank.
output: Review required: MPN and Manufacturer are missing.
Keep this row separate for manual completion; do not invent part details.

output_examples.input: Two rows have MPN X100 and quantity 1 each, but their manufacturers are Alpha Components and Beta Components.
output: The manufacturer values differ, so the documented merge criteria are not met.

best_practices: Preserve the original BOM and review proposed column mappings before applying changes.
Confirm both MPN and Manufacturer match before merging, then reconcile quantities and reference designators.
Resolve flagged missing fields manually and validate any separately obtained implementation before processing production files.
anti_patterns: Assuming the public guide includes the referenced executable or guarantees deterministic results.
Merging rows solely by similar descriptions or matching MPNs while ignoring manufacturers.
Inventing missing part numbers, quantities, or manufacturer names to complete a BOM.

faq.question: Does this package include a working normalizer?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains only the guide; the referenced Python CLI and supporting assets are not included.

faq.question: Which input formats does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes CSV and XLSX inputs from EDA tools such as Altium, KiCad, and Eagle. Executable format support is not verifiable here.

faq.question: How are duplicate components identified?
faq.answer: The guide uses both manufacturer part number and manufacturer name as merge criteria, with quantities summed for matching rows.

faq.question: How are reference designators formatted?
faq.answer: The documented format uses uppercase reference designators separated by commas.

faq.question: What happens when required fields are missing?
faq.answer: The guide calls for a separate review CSV for missing MPN, Qty, or Manufacturer values. No exporter is included.

faq.question: Does it retrieve current prices or stock levels?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes local normalization without external pricing or availability lookups.
